Class LoginMessageListener

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.spigot.core.listeners.LoginMessageListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
IRestartable, org.bukkit.event.Listener
@Singleton public final class LoginMessageListener extends Object
Represents a listener that keeps track of Players logging in to send them any messages if needed.
